document_check.note: The document is Hessen E (2025), 'Mild cognitive impairment and neuropsychological examination', Front. Psychol. 16:1662151, article type Review. It covers the NIA-AA, DSM-5 and ICD-11 domain frameworks (pp3-4) and the Jak/Bondi failure criterion: at least two tests in a domain below 1 SD (p4), described on p8 as 'more than one test in the same cognitive domain below 1 standard deviation'. It matches both cited sentences.

cited_result: Descriptive statements: the diagnostic systems use domain-based criterion frameworks (NIA-AA, DSM-5, ICD-11), and the comprehensive neuropsychological failure criterion is more than one test per domain below about 1 SD (pp3-4, 8).
tool_reason: This is a narrative, non-systematic review ('not based on a comprehensive review of the field', p1), and it is cited only for descriptive statements about diagnostic frameworks, not for an empirical estimate, so no risk-of-bias tool fits.
overall_rationale: The paper has no participants, no systematic search and no estimate or synthesis, and the review cites it only for descriptions of criterion frameworks. ROBIS is designed for systematic reviews and does not apply to a self-declared non-comprehensive narrative review.
